description: ReactOS path provisioning STUB. ReactOS is a standalone Windows-NT-compatible OS with NO apt; 'minimal OS + first-boot apt-get' does not apply. ReactOS provisions applications through its own package manager (RAPPS) after the system is installed from bootcd.iso. The ISO itself is produced by windows/build-shape.sh reactos (compiled, baked), not by apt. This descriptor records that choice so the OS Creator does not attempt an apt provision on the ReactOS path.

firstBoot: rem ReactOS provisions apps via RAPPS post-install; no apt. See windows/BUILD.md Path 2.
